title: Process Simulate workflows and connector status
description: Explore Process Simulate workflow ideas in Vector OS. Connector status: Upcoming. Development and release dates have not been announced.

Siemens

Process Simulate

Tecnomatix Process Simulate supports manufacturing-process planning, robotics and human simulation.

On the software discovery list. Connector development and release dates have not been announced.

Workflow ideas

Lay out an assembly process

Start from the selected part, stock, machine or cell layout. In the intended Process Simulate preview, lay out an assembly process; the visible result is a process setup with work coordinates, resources and target geometry visible. Review orientation, reach, tooling and fixture assumptions before accepting or exporting it.

Simulate robot operations

Begin with the chosen operations, tools or robot tasks. In the intended Process Simulate preview, simulate robot operations; the visible result is a generated path or production sequence over the same setup. Review clearance, collisions, limits, feeds and operation order before accepting or exporting it.

Review ergonomics and cycle time

Use the simulated material removal, robot motion or process results. In the intended Process Simulate preview, review ergonomics and cycle time; the visible result is a verification view with remaining stock, reach or cycle data exposed. Review collisions, code target, cycle time and safe human approval before accepting or exporting it.
